pr_title: Fix todoist filtering custom projects by labels
pr_body:
<!--
  You are amazing! Thanks for contributing to our project!

-->
## Breaking change
<!--
  If your PR contains a breaking change for existing users, it is important
  to tell them what breaks, how to make it work again and why we did this.
  This piece of text is published with the release notes, so it helps if you
  write it towards our users, not us.
  Note: Remove this section if this PR is NOT a breaking change.
-->
Labels used by custom projects for filtering are case-sensitive. Previously there were automatically lower-cased by the integration, but in Todoist a label like `Test` and `test` are considered unique. Because of that labels will now by case sensitive in your configuration.

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
This fixes an issue with creating a custom project filtering by labels. The custom project calendar's state was never `on` even if there were calendar events due that had that label.  This was due to comparing the label id to the task labels instead of the name of the label.  The actual rest API [returns an array of strings](https://developer.todoist.com/rest/v2/?shell#tasks), not label ids.  

An example from the docs:

```json
[
    {
        "creator_id": "2671355",
        "created_at": "2019-12-11T22:36:50.000000Z",
        "assignee_id": "2671362",
        "assigner_id": "2671355",
        "comment_count": 10,
        "is_completed": false,
        "content": "Buy Milk",
        "description": "",
        "due": {
            "date": "2016-09-01",
            "is_recurring": false,
            "datetime": "2016-09-01T12:00:00.000000Z",
            "string": "tomorrow at 12",
            "timezone": "Europe/Moscow"
        },
        "id": "2995104339",
        "labels": ["Food", "Shopping"],
        "order": 1,
        "priority": 1,
        "project_id": "2203306141",
        "section_id": "7025",
        "parent_id": "2995104589",
        "url": "https://todoist.com/showTask?id=2995104339"
    },
    ...
]
```

issue_context.title: Todoist integration custom projects not working
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The "custom projects" feature of the Todoist integration is not working correctly. I have a custom project defined for a specific Todoist label, and within Todoist, a single task is tagged with that label. However, within Home Assistant, I see all of my Todoist projects on the calendar, along with the custom project.

First - I wouldn't expect to see all of my projects. Only those defined in configuration.yaml should be imported. In my case, there should only be one calendar, representing my custom project.

Second - my custom project is pulling in ALL of my Todoist tasks, not just the one tagged with the label defined in configuration.yaml.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2023.2.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Todoist

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/todoist/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
calendar:
  - platform: todoist
    token: xxxxxx
    custom_projects:
      - name: 'HAtest'
        labels:
          - HAtest
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

I can confirm that I see the behavior above after upgrading to 2023.2.0 as well.
I can confirm the same error using the latest docker stable image (Core version 2023.2.0)

> First - I wouldn't expect to see all of my projects. Only those defined in configuration.yaml should be imported. In my case, there should only be one calendar, representing my custom project.

I took a look back at the code prior to the recent changes.  As far as I can tell this is how it always worked.  All projects and tasks are imported.  There isn't currently a way to only import certain projects. You can create a custom project that only includes tasks from certain projects and labels, but all other projects would still be imported in addition to your custom project(s).

> Second - my custom project is pulling in ALL of my Todoist tasks, not just the one tagged with the label defined in configuration.yaml.

I was also able to reproduce this, so there is a bug with custom projects using labels :+1: It appears the label is applied to all tasks even when that task doesn't have that label in todoist.

> I took a look back at the code prior to the recent changes. As far as I can tell this is how it always worked. All projects and tasks are imported. There isn't currently a way to only import certain projects. You can create a custom project that only includes tasks from certain projects and labels, but all other projects would still be imported in addition to your custom project(s).

It may not have been intended, but I can confirm what @simonostendorf is stating was the prior behavior.  I have around 20 projects in todoist, and before things broke, it was only creating calendar entities for the projects I defined as custom projects.  Now I have 20+ calendar entities.  It may have been a bug that some of us thought was a nice feature :)

review_comments: Labels are case sensitive, so it's fine to have `Test` or `test` but they are treated as different labels in todoist.  Because of this we need to remove the lower-casing of any provided labels.
